description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 10.0 with a tick label interval of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", also has a linear scale, ranging from 18 to 28 with a tick label interval of 2. The plot displays four lines representing different models: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (magenta dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at around 18.5 BLEU at 0.0 AL and increases to approximately 27 BLEU at 10.0 AL, with a notable rise between 2.5 and 5.0 AL. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at around 19 BLEU at 0.0 AL and reaches about 27 BLEU at 10.0 AL, showing a steady increase across the AL range. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at around 18 BLEU at 0.0 AL and rises to approximately 27 BLEU at 10.0 AL, closely following the trend of Inconsistency-CE. The Consistency-Bi line starts at around 22 BLEU at 0.0 AL, increases to a peak of approximately 29 BLEU at 8.75 AL, and then slightly decreases to around 28.5 BLEU at 10.0 AL.
